name: Dusklight
by: Twilit Realm, on the Twilight Princess decompilation (zeldaret/tp)
about: Twilight Princess rebuilt from its decompiled code: higher resolutions and frame rates, quality-of-life options, cheats, gyro and mouse aim, achievements. Plays from your own GameCube or Wii disc image. The first start asks once whether to send crash reports, then shows its game modes: press Play.

game.title: The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess
game.why: Your own GameCube or Wii disc image of Twilight Princess (any release except the Korean Wii one).

settings.label: Frame rate cap
settings.desc: Used when frame interpolation is Capped.

settings.label: Frame interpolation
settings.desc: Smooths motion above the game’s own 30 FPS.

settings.label: Menu scale
settings.desc: Scales the Dusklight interface; the game’s HUD is unchanged.

settings.label: Texture packs
settings.desc: Uses texture packs from the texture_replacements folder.

settings.label: Language
settings.desc: Only languages your copy has.

settings.label: Enable VSync
settings.desc: Synchronizes the frame rate to your monitor's refresh rate.

settings.label: Lock 4:3 Aspect Ratio
settings.desc: Lock the game's aspect ratio to the original.

settings.label: Pause on Focus Lost
settings.desc: Pause the game when window focus is lost.

settings.label: Enable Mini-Map Shadows
settings.desc: Render a thick shadow around the mini-map. May impact performance.

settings.label: Disable Cutscene Pillarboxing
settings.desc: Disable black bars on the left and right sides of the screen

settings.label: Allow Background Inputs
settings.desc: Allow inputs even when the game window is not focused.

settings.label: Free Camera
settings.desc: Enables free camera control, letting you control the camera fully with the C-Stick.

settings.label: Invert Camera X Axis
settings.desc:
Invert horizontal camera movement.

Applies to the control stick only.

settings.label: Invert Camera Y Axis
settings.desc:
Invert vertical camera movement.

Applies to the control stick only.

settings.label: Invert First Person X Axis
settings.desc:
Invert horizontal movement while aiming with items or first person camera.

Applies to the control stick only.

settings.label: Invert First Person Y Axis
settings.desc:
Invert vertical movement while aiming with items or first person camera.

Applies to the control stick only.

settings.label: Gyro Aim
settings.desc: Enables gyro controls while in look mode, aiming a hawk, and aiming

settings.label: Gyro Rollgoal
settings.desc: Enables gyro controls for Rollgoal in Hena's Cabin.

settings.label: Invert Gyro Pitch
settings.desc: Invert vertical gyro aiming.

settings.label: Invert Gyro Yaw
settings.desc: Invert horizontal gyro aiming.

settings.label: Mouse Aim
settings.desc: Enables mouse input while in look mode, aiming a hawk, and aiming

settings.label: Mouse Camera
settings.desc: Enables mouse input for controlling the third-person camera.

settings.label: Invert Mouse Y
settings.desc: Invert vertical mouse control for both aiming and camera.

settings.label: Mouse/Touch in Menus
settings.desc: Enables mouse and touch input for supported in-game menus.

settings.label: Invert Air/Swim X Axis
settings.desc: Invert horizontal movement while flying or swimming.

settings.label: Invert Air/Swim Y Axis
settings.desc: Invert vertical movement while flying or swimming.

settings.label: Swap Direct Select Input
settings.desc: Swap the controls for using Direct Select on the item wheel, making Direct Select the default and holding L to scroll the wheel.

settings.label: Turbo Key
settings.desc: Hold Tab to increase game speed by up to 4x.

settings.label: Enable Reverb
settings.desc: Enables the reverb effect in game audio.

settings.label: Dusklight Menu Sounds
settings.desc: Play sound effects when navigating the Dusklight menu.

settings.label: No Low HP Sound
settings.desc: Disable the beeping sound when having low health.

settings.label: Non-Stop Midna's Lament
settings.desc: Prevents enemy music while Midna's Lament is playing.

settings.label: Mirror Mode
settings.desc: Mirrors the world horizontally, matching the Wii version of the game.

settings.label: Minimal HUD
settings.desc:
Disables the elements of the main HUD of the game.
Useful for a more immersive

settings.label: Restore Wii 1.0 Glitches
settings.desc: Restores patched glitches from Wii USA 1.0, the first released version.

settings.label: Enable Rotating Link Doll
settings.desc: Enables rotating Link in the collection menu with the C-Stick.

settings.label: Hide Owl Statue Markers
settings.desc: Removes completed Owl Statue markers from the map and Minimap.

settings.label: Instant Death
settings.desc: Any hit will instantly kill you.

settings.label: No Heart Drops
settings.desc: Hearts will never drop from enemies, pots, and various other places.

settings.label: Bigger Wallets
settings.desc: Wallet sizes are like in the HD version. (500, 1000, 2000)

settings.label: Disable Rupee Cutscenes
settings.desc: Rupees will not play cutscenes after you have collected them the first time.

settings.label: Faster Scene Transitions
settings.desc: Reduces how long the transitions take when changing maps.

settings.label: Faster Climbing
settings.desc: Quicker climbing on ladders and vines like the HD version.

settings.label: Faster Tears of Light
settings.desc: Tears of Light dropped by Shadow Insects pop out faster like the HD version.

settings.label: Autosave
settings.desc: Autosaves the game when going to a new area or opening a dungeon door.

settings.label: Instant Saves
settings.desc: Skips the delay when writing to the Memory Card.

settings.label: Hold B for Instant Text
settings.desc: Makes text scroll immediately by holding B.

settings.label: Hold Button to Mash
settings.desc: Hold the indicated button to mash automatically.

settings.label: No Climbing Miss Animation
settings.desc: Prevents Link from playing a struggle animation when grabbing ledges or

settings.label: No Rupee Returns
settings.desc: Always collect Rupees even if your Wallet is too full.

settings.label: No Sword Recoil
settings.desc: Link will not recoil when his sword hits walls.

settings.label: No 2nd Fish for Cat
settings.desc: Skip needing to catch a second fish for Sera's cat.

settings.label: Button Fishing
settings.desc: Allow fishing with the Fishing Rod using the button the item is assigned to.

settings.label: Show Poe Count on Map
settings.desc: Displays collected/total number of Poe Souls for a region on the map.

settings.label: Sun's Song (R+X)
settings.desc: Allows Wolf Link to howl and change the time of day.

settings.label: Quick Transform (R+Y)
settings.desc: Transform instantly by pressing R and Y simultaneously.

settings.label: Aiming Reticle
settings.desc: Shows the aiming reticle for bow and slingshot.

settings.label: No Hit Stun
settings.desc: Disables hit stun frames after attacks.

settings.label: Speedrun Mode
settings.desc: Enables Speedrun game mode option in the Dusklight launch menu.

settings.label: LiveSplit Connection
settings.desc: Connect to LiveSplit server on localhost:16834. For this to work you must right click LiveSplit, and turn on Control -> Start TCP Server.

settings.label: Show RTA
settings.desc: Display the RTA timer. IGT is always visible.

settings.label: Infinite Hearts
settings.desc: Keeps your health full.

settings.label: Infinite Arrows
settings.desc: Keeps your arrow count full.

settings.label: Infinite Seeds
settings.desc: Keeps your slingshot pellets (seeds) full.

settings.label: Infinite Bombs
settings.desc: Keeps all bomb bags full.

settings.label: Infinite Oil
settings.desc: Keeps your lantern oil full.

settings.label: Infinite Oxygen
settings.desc: Keeps your underwater oxygen meter full.

settings.label: Infinite Rupees
settings.desc: Keeps your rupee count full.

settings.label: No Item Timer
settings.desc: Item drops such as rupees and hearts will never disappear after they drop.

settings.label: Moon Jump (R+A)
settings.desc: Hold R and A to rise into the air.

settings.label: Easy Quick Spin (R+B)
settings.desc: Hold R to always do a Quick Spin when attacking with B.

settings.label: Super Clawshot
settings.desc: Extends Clawshot behavior beyond the normal game rules.

settings.label: Fast Iron Boots
settings.desc: Speeds up movement while heavy, including wearing the Iron Boots, holding the Ball and Chain, wearing Magic Armor without rupees, etc.

settings.label: Can Transform Anywhere
settings.desc: Allows transforming even if NPCs are looking.

settings.label: Fast Roll
settings.desc: Makes Link's roll animation and movement twice as fast.

settings.label: Fast Spinner
settings.desc: Speeds up Spinner movement while holding R.

settings.label: Invincible Enemies
settings.desc: Prevents enemies from taking damage.

settings.label: Infinite Epona Stamina
settings.desc: Prevents Epona's stamina from depleting.

settings.label: Show Shader Compilation
settings.desc: Show an overlay when shaders are being compiled for your hardware.

settings.label: Enable Discord Rich Presence
settings.desc: Enable Dusklight to integrate with Discord Rich Presence. This allows Discord to show your status in-game.

settings.label: Show Input Viewer
settings.desc: Display a controller input overlay while playing.

settings.label: Show Gyro Input Viewer
settings.desc: Show gyro sensor values in the input viewer.

settings.label: Skip TV Settings Screen
settings.desc: Skips the TV calibration screen shown when loading a save.
